## Digital Textile Printing FAQs
Direct, plain-language answers about digital textile printing and job work in Surat.
###
Digital textile printing is a process where a digital design file is printed directly with specialised dye inks instead of screens. It reproduces fine detail, smooth gradients and many colours without making a separate screen for each colour, which suits short runs, sampling and frequently changing designs.
###
Yes. Lado Rani Creation takes bulk job-work orders from saree manufacturers, garment producers and textile traders in Surat and surrounding markets, with batch-to-batch colour consistency and coordinated scheduling.
###
Yes. Emerging labels, fashion designers and custom creators can enquire. Smaller sample batches and custom runs are scheduled according to machine capacity and the current production pipeline.

## Which Fabrics Can Be Sublimation Printed?
Sublimation printing works on polyester-based and synthetic-blend fabrics. Pure natural fibres such as 100% cotton and pure silk need a different printing chemistry.
Fabric suitability for sublimation printing |
| Fabric | Suitable? | Typical use
| Poly-crepe, poly-georgette, poly-chiffon | Yes | Sarees, dupattas, dress materials
| Poly-satin, poly-silk, organza | Yes | Ethnic wear, fashion fabrics
| Dry-fit sportswear fabric, micro-polyester | Yes | Jerseys, uniforms, activewear
| Synthetic curtain fabric, velvet, upholstery blends | Yes | Curtains, cushions, home furnishing
| Polyester-cotton blends | Depends on polyester content | Confirm with a sample strike-off
| 100% cotton, pure natural silk | No | Needs a different printing chemistry

## Digital Printing vs Transfer / Fusing
Printing puts the design onto paper or fabric; transfer or fusing is the heat step that bonds it permanently into the fibres.
How the two steps differ |
| Aspect | Digital textile printing | Transfer / fusing
| What it does | Reproduces the design with specialised dye inks | Bonds the printed design permanently into the fabric with heat
| When it happens | First production step | After printing
| At Lado Rani Creation | Core job-work service | Provided only where agreed for the order

## Printing Services FAQs
Fabric suitability, sublimation paper printing, fusing and sampling, answered directly.
###
Polyester-based and synthetic-blend fabrics are suitable, including poly-crepe, poly-georgette, poly-chiffon, poly-satin, dry-fit sportswear fabric, micro-polyester and synthetic curtain materials. Sublimation dyes bond with polyester fibres under heat, so the higher the polyester content, the better the result.
###
No. Pure cotton and pure natural silk do not bond with sublimation disperse dyes, so prints on them fade or wash out. These fibres need a different printing chemistry. Share your fabric composition and the team will confirm whether it is suitable.
###
Sublimation paper printing is the step where a design is printed onto special transfer paper with disperse dye inks. The printed paper is then pressed against polyester fabric with heat, which turns the dye into gas and bonds it permanently into the fibres.
###
Digital textile printing is the machine process that reproduces the design with specialised inks. Transfer or fusing is the heat step that bonds the print permanently into the fabric. At Lado Rani Creation, printing is the core job work, and fusing is provided only where it is agreed for the order.
###
Yes. A sample strike-off can be printed on your specified fabric so you can check colour, pattern scale and feel before the bulk run is started.

# Transparent 5-Step Printing Workflow
From initial file review to final roll delivery, our Surat production workflow is structured for consistency, precision, and reliable communication.

## Transparent 5-Step Printing Workflow
From initial file review to final roll delivery, our Surat production facility is organised for consistent shades and dependable turnaround.
-
1

### Design & Fabric Handover
Share your digital artwork files (TIFF/PDF/AI/JPG) along with exact fabric specifications, base color, and required meterage.
-
2

### Suitability & Quote Confirmation
Our technical team checks fabric suitability, color profile requirements, quantity parameters, and mutually confirms rates and timelines.
-
3

### High-Precision Digital Printing
Designs are digitally printed using high-density sublimation technology, calibrated dye inks, and precise tension controls.
-
4

### Transfer / Fusing (Where Agreed)
For orders with agreed fusing support, prints are thermally bonded onto suitable polyester fabric under controlled temperature.
-
5

### Quality Check & Dispatch
Rolls undergo thorough visual inspection for color depth and consistency before being packaged for collection or delivery from Surat.

## Printing Process FAQs
Design files, fusing, colour consistency and quality checks, answered directly.
###
Yes. You can send your own artwork as a high-resolution TIFF, PDF, AI, PSD or JPG file with seamless repeats. The team checks resolution, repeat alignment and colour before printing.
###
No. Transfer or fusing onto fabric is carried out only when it is agreed as part of the order, and only on fabric confirmed as suitable for the process.
###
Colour profiles used for each job are stored digitally, so a reorder placed later can be printed with the same settings as the original batch, and each lot is checked visually before dispatch.
###
Every roll is inspected for colour depth and consistency before it is packed for collection or delivery from Surat.

## Dedicated Job-Work Support in the Textile Capital of India
Located at 1st Floor, Jay Industrial Estate, Plot No 244, 2, Anjana, Surat, Gujarat 395002 , Lado Rani Creation operates at the heart of India's foremost textile production hub.
We bridge the gap between creative fashion design and industrial scale execution. Whether serving high-volume saree manufacturers in Ring Road markets or boutique designers across India, our production lines are calibrated to deliver clean color gradients, reliable repeats, and honest technical guidance.
Our Mission
Provide textile manufacturers with high-precision digital printing that elevates fabric value and accelerates market delivery.
Our Vision
To be a trusted name in Surat for consistent digital textile printing through continuous technology adoption and customer trust.

## The Principles Guiding Our Production
Every job work lot that enters our Surat facility is managed with care, technical diligence, and accountability.

### Precision in Every Print
Our founding motto. Every millimetre of fabric is audited for dot alignment, smooth tonal transitions, and sharp pattern edges.

### Design Privacy & Security
We treat client artwork with strict confidentiality. Your proprietary prints, seasonal motifs, and designer files are never shared or resold.

### Repeat Batch Consistency
Colour profiles for each job are stored digitally, so reorders placed weeks or months later can be printed with the same settings.

### Rooted in Surat’s Textile Heart
Situated in Jay Industrial Estate, Anjana, Surat, which makes pickup and transport to the city’s major textile markets straightforward.
Eco-Friendly Manufacturing

## Dry Sublimation Transfer Process
Unlike traditional wet printing, which needs washing stages after printing, sublimation transfer printing is a dry process : disperse dye inks are printed on paper and bonded into polyester fabric with heat, without a wash-off step.
Dry Transfer Process • No Wash-Off Stage

Yes. Client artwork is treated as confidential. Your designs, seasonal motifs and files are used only for your order and are never shared or resold.
###
The sublimation transfer process prints dye onto paper and bonds it to fabric with heat, so the printing step does not need the washing stages used in traditional wet printing.

## How a Job-Work Order Works
- Share your design file and fabric details on WhatsApp, by phone or through the enquiry form.
- The team confirms fabric suitability, rates and the delivery timeline.
- Your design is digitally printed at the Surat unit.
- Where agreed, the print is transferred or fused onto your fabric.
- Rolls are quality-checked, then packed for collection or delivery. Full 5-step process

# Privacy Policy
Last updated: 2026-10-22
This policy explains how Lado Rani Creation (“we”, “us”) handles information when you use www.ladoranicreation.com or contact us.

## Information you share with us
When you send an enquiry, you may share your name, company, phone or WhatsApp number, email, fabric type, quantity, timeline and design files. The enquiry form on this website does not store your details on our server: it opens WhatsApp with your message filled in, and you choose whether to send it.

## How we use it
- To reply to your enquiry and prepare a quotation.
- To process, print and deliver your order.
- To keep a record of colour settings for reorders.
We do not sell or rent your personal information. Client artwork is used only for your order and is never shared or resold.

## Analytics and cookies
If website analytics is enabled, we use Google Analytics to understand how visitors use the site (for example, which pages are viewed). It uses cookies and does not tell us who you are. The embedded Google Map is provided by Google and may set its own cookies. Your light/dark theme choice is saved in your browser only.

## Third-party services
Messages sent through WhatsApp, phone or email are handled by those providers under their own privacy policies. Links to Google Maps, Instagram and Facebook take you to sites with their own policies.

## Your choices
You can ask us what information we hold about you, or ask us to correct or delete it, by emailing Ladoranicreation99@gmail.com or calling +91 70166 33928 .

## Contact
Lado Rani Creation , 1st Floor, Jay Industrial Estate, Plot No 244, 2, Anjana, Surat, Gujarat 395002 . See also our Terms of Use .
